command:
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED=84b31d08bac81b6f46e44d11ccfe06071438b66a
git fetch origin main agent-control
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
test "$(git status --short)" = ' M docs/STABILITY_RECOVERY_GUIDE.md'
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('docs/STABILITY_RECOVERY_GUIDE.md')
s=p.read_text().rstrip() + '\n'
p.write_text(s)
PY
git diff --check
grep -q 'SOFTWARE GATE PASS; DEVICE ACCEPTANCE PENDING' docs/STABILITY_RECOVERY_GUIDE.md
grep -q 'Phase 2 device acceptance' docs/STABILITY_RECOVERY_GUIDE.md
grep -q '84b31d08bac81b6f46e44d11ccfe06071438b66a' docs/STABILITY_RECOVERY_GUIDE.md
git add docs/STABILITY_RECOVERY_GUIDE.md
git diff --cached --check
git commit -m 'Record Phase 2 software gate'
git push origin HEAD:main
echo FINAL_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
